name: Is it better to repair a slab leak directly or re-route the pipe?

mainEntity.name: Is it better to repair a slab leak directly or re-route the pipe?

acceptedAnswer.text: The decision to repair a slab leak directly or re-route the pipe depends on several factors, including the pipe's condition, the leak's location, accessibility, and overall cost-effectiveness. Direct repair involves opening the slab at the leak point. Re-routing involves bypassing the damaged section with a new pipe, often through walls or the attic. A professional plumber will assess your specific situation and recommend the most durable and cost-efficient solution for your home.
acceptedAnswer.description: Direct repair versus re-routing depends on the leak's location, pipe condition, and overall cost, best decided with a professional plumber.
